ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Uplink Center — Verdant Exchange R2
ObjectStates.Description:
Drop on STAGE > DROP BAGS HERE.
Verdant Exchange | Botanical research and communications campus.
48 × 48 inches; 300-point Uplink Center.
16-inch deployment zones from opposite X edges. Two 40 mm Antennas at (0,-12)/(0,+12), central 40 mm Tech-Coffin.
14 varied buildings including four glazed conservatories, four two-storey labs/data centres, seed archives and utility houses. Furnished interiors, real openings, permanent ladders, crop beds, irrigation and service equipment.
Individual day/night backgrounds. Right-side controls, Booty, Metachemistry, independent DZ guides and per-player mission reference. Live TTS physics and playtesting remain unverified.

ContainedObjects.Description: Glazed roof follows the parent greenhouse state automatically. Only the central metal service spine is a roof walkway.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local parent="46ca9b"
local home="{\"x\": -6, \"y\": 1.0, \"z\": -17}"

local colors={'White','Brown','Red','Orange','Yellow','Green','Teal','Blue','Purple','Pink','Grey','Black'}
local timer=nil
local function sync()
 local p=getObjectFromGUID(parent)
 local visible=p and not p.isDestroyed()
 if visible then local a=p.getPosition();visible=math.abs(a.x)<26 and math.abs(a.z)<26 and a.y<20 end
 self.setPosition(visible and JSON.decode(home) or {90,24,90})
 self.setInvisibleTo(visible and {} or colors)
end
function onLoad()self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false;timer=Wait.time(sync,.3,-1);Wait.frames(sync,4)end
function onDestroy()if timer then Wait.stop(timer)end end
